provenance.reviewers: 4 read-only subagents (correctness, security, tests, ticket-fit; sonnet) + CI/SonarCloud

findings.title: Deep page offsets as an unauthenticated DoS through huge OFFSET scans
findings.observation: page=100000000&size=20 passes validation and was claimed to make Postgres walk ~2 billion index entries.
findings.why: OFFSET past the last row stops at table end; costs no more than the count.

findings.title: lastName has no server-side length cap
findings.observation: the 80-character limit exists only in the frontend input; a multi-KB prefix reaches both queries.
findings.why: unchanged pre-existing behaviour; Tomcat already caps the request line at 8 KB.

findings.title: Task 4.4 not done: no comment on #25, Bizu not told
findings.observation: the narrowed Name/City scope and the breaking envelope are never communicated on #25.
findings.why: publishing on GitHub waits for the human to approve the drafted comment.

findings.title: Global handler turns every controller's type-mismatch 500 into 400
findings.observation: /api/owners/abc, /api/pets/abc now answer 400 instead of 500, beyond the owner list.
findings.why: deliberate, recorded under Assumptions; openapi.yaml already documents 400 everywhere.

findings.title: Add Owner now always rendered, outside the table
findings.observation: the button used to appear only after data arrived; it now shows while loading and on error.
findings.why: openspec/changes/paginate-sort-owners/design.md:74 requires Add Owner across loading/empty/error layouts.

findings.title: Hand-rolled query codec, getOwners/searchOwners removed
findings.observation: the custom encoder and the deleted public methods widen the frontend change beyond the ticket.
findings.why: default codec sends '+' raw; openspec/changes/paginate-sort-owners/design.md:68 asks one query path.

findings.title: Owner deleted between page query and graph fetch makes the list 500
findings.observation: a concurrent delete between the two SELECTs misses the map lookup and throws IllegalStateException; no test covers the race.
findings.why: openspec/changes/paginate-sort-owners/design.md:44 says surface a missing owner, never drop it.

findings.title: Latency proxy test now needs exactly 10 owners and was never run
findings.observation: hasSize(10) ties the load test to the default page size, and nothing executed it.
findings.why: 10 is the specified default; not running it is openspec/changes/paginate-sort-owners/tasks.md:15.

findings.title: Index tests check existence, not that queries use them
findings.observation: no EXPLAIN proves the bound-parameter LIKE plus ORDER BY uses the indexes; 100k behaviour is unproven.
findings.why: plan and volume measurement deferred by openspec/changes/paginate-sort-owners/design.md:60.

findings.title: City-sort test orders with Java compareTo, not DB collation
findings.observation: isSortedAccordingTo(String::compareTo) assumes Java and Postgres agree on the seeded cities.
findings.why: seeded cities differ in their first letters; any collation agrees. Paging test uses ASCII.

findings.title: A failed first load leaves nothing to retry
findings.observation: initial GET fails, so there is an error banner, an empty table and no paginator.
findings.why: Find Owner resubmits the query; it is the retry.

findings.title: Sonar: duplicated literal "Validation failed: {}"
findings.observation: the log pattern now appears four times in the advice.
findings.why: three pre-existed; a constant for a log pattern reads worse.

findings.title: Sonar: prefer String#replaceAll
findings.why: tsconfig lib is es2017; replaceAll does not typecheck.

autofixes.title: A failed page load left paginator and sort describing an unloaded page
autofixes.observation: fail() cleared the rows but kept the new pageIndex/sort and the old total, so after a failed Next the paginator read "11 – 20 of 26" over an empty table.
autofixes.fix: remember the state of the last loaded page and restore it on failure, keeping its rows.

autofixes.title: Type-mismatch 400 echoed raw caller input into the log and body
autofixes.observation: ?page=<CRLF or huge string> was written verbatim by log.warn and reflected into ProblemDetail.detail, allowing forged log lines and log flooding.
autofixes.fix: name only the parameter, never the rejected value.

autofixes.title: Invalid-parameter tests asserted only the HTTP status
autofixes.observation: any 400, whatever its body, satisfied the test, so a regression in the ProblemDetail shape would pass unnoticed.
autofixes.fix: assert the ProblemDetail title and a non-empty detail.

autofixes.title: release.md stated verifications without saying where they came from
autofixes.observation: the rollback compatibility check and the 3-SELECT budget were asserted with no test or command to back them.
autofixes.fix: name OwnerListPagingTest, and describe the one-off Flyway validation as one-off.

autofixes.title: Sonar: generic length assertions and mutable injected members
autofixes.observation: expect(x.length).toBe(n) reports badly on failure; constructor-injected services were not readonly.
autofixes.fix: toHaveSize, and private readonly on the injected services.

assumptions.title: A type mismatch on any endpoint answers 400, not 500
assumptions.alternative: parse page/size as strings inside listOwners only
assumptions.why: The catch-all advice turned Spring's natural 400 into a 500, and the contract already lists 400 for every operation. Held down because the spec says other owner contracts stay unchanged.

assumptions.title: Empty size=, sort=, page= fall back to the defaults
assumptions.why: Spring's defaultValue treats a blank value as missing, and the spec lists only explicit bad values. Nothing in the ticket or Q&A decides blanks either way.

assumptions.title: A page whose offset overflows an int is a 400
assumptions.alternative: accept it and answer an empty page beyond the last
assumptions.why: Hibernate takes an int first-result, so the offset would wrap silently. The spec's "unrepresentable page numbers" is read as covering this.

assumptions.title: On a failed load the last loaded page stays, with its controls
assumptions.alternative: clear the rows and keep the failing page's controls
assumptions.why: Keeps rows, paginator and sort header consistent beside the error, and clicking again retries. The spec only asks for an explicit error, not what happens to the rows.

assumptions.title: Every list request sends all four parameters explicitly
assumptions.alternative: omit parameters equal to the server defaults
assumptions.why: The grid's state is always complete, and an explicit URL makes traces and tests unambiguous. Defaults stay usable for other clients.

assumptions.title: Commas stay unescaped in query values
assumptions.why: A comma is a legal sub-delimiter in a query, and keeping it keeps sort=name,asc readable in diagrams. Every other reserved character is encoded.

assumptions.title: The last-name prefix is submitted untrimmed
assumptions.alternative: trim whitespace before submitting the search
assumptions.why: The old screen sent the text as typed, and the spec says preserve filtering semantics. A trailing space now matches nothing, as before.
